sentences.text: The petitioner, who was arrested on 05.01.2023 is seeking regular bail under section 439 Cr.P.C. in connection with Garchuk P.S. Case No. 02/2023 under sections 341/376 IPC read with Section 6/8 of POCSO Act.

The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the mother of the alleged minor girl was carrying out some illegal business from her house and when the petitioner was objected to the same,
he was falsely implicated of sexually assaulting her 10 years old daughter.

It is also submitted that the wife of the petitioner is pregnant and the estimated date of delivery of child is on 26.03.2023 and in support of the same, some medical documents have been annexed.
The learned APP has produced the case diary and has opposed the prayer for bail.
On perusal of the case diary, it appears

that the victim girl is 10 years old and in her statement given to (i) the Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Kamrup (M), Guwahati, (ii) to the I.O. under Section 161 CrPC, as well as (iii) in her statement recorded before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class under Section 164 CrPC, she has made consistent statement of being subjected to penetrative sexual assault by the petitioner.
Under such circumstances, notwithstanding that the wife of the petitioner is expecting a child birth,
this is not a fit case to release the petitioner, namely, Kamal Hussain on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail is rejected.
